prompt: Bug report: K-Means on CPU with sparse CSR input (method::lloyd_csr) and `compute_exact_objective_function` enabled reports an objective function value that is systematically too small. Training on the same data materialized as a dense table (method::lloyd_dense) from the same initial centroids gives the same centroids and assignments, but a larger (correct) objective value. With n_init > 1 in scikit-learn-intelex this makes the wrong trial get picked as best. Find and fix the root cause in the library so the CSR objective matches the dense one. `bazel` is on PATH; this machine has no GPU. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
